evidence.reference: 姫様ＬＯＶＥライフ！ (Princess Sugar, 2015-08): x86 game executable named after the title, importing DDRAW/DINPUT/DSOUND/d3d9/d3dx9_43. Five *.aos archives (bgm 61 MB, cv 675 MB, grp 2.99 GB, scr 2.5 MB, se 14 MB); every one of them starts with four zero bytes, two little-endian u32 fields, and its own file name as NUL-terminated ASCII at offset 12. Static probe 2026-09-05.

Same title, runtime measurement 2026-09-05 via injector --launch --hold with the original ISO mounted read-only (Mount-DiskImage, dismounted afterwards; nothing installed). Without the disc the game only shows a #32770 message box asking for it. With the disc: the visible window class is SFA, hook_diagnostics = StartupAudioHooksReady|LunaHostReady|LunaConnected, and the generic Windows audio path published non-silent PCM (44100/2/16, voice_clips rising to 57, peak 14570). luna_active stayed 0 and text_events stayed 0 on the title screen, so no text capability is claimed.
